list: the official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18 (verified against Exophase / PSNProfiles via PlanetGTA6)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Collect the other 54 trophies and this one is automatic — no DLC, no multiplayer, no difficulty setting stands between you and it. In practice A Long Road (100% completion) is the last trophy most players earn, so follow the roadmap: story first, then the 100% checklist, then strangers and cleanup.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: See the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end — the trophy pops on its own as the story opens. No story trophy can be missed, and there is no mission replay, so keeping a manual save at the start of each chapter is a sensible safety net.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 1 to its end; the trophy unlocks the moment the chapter closes. The story spans five chapters and roughly 60 to 80 hours, and nothing in it can be missed except the first meditation spot (see Positive Mental Attitude) — meditate at Jason's house before Chapter 1 ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 2 to its end; the trophy unlocks the moment the chapter closes. Once Jason and Lucia are both playable in Chapter 2, most of the list opens up — a good time to start scanning vehicles and studying animals toward the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 3 to its end; the trophy unlocks the moment the chapter closes. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter — with no mission replay and no New Game Plus, a save per chapter is the only way back.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 4 to its end; the trophy unlocks the moment the chapter closes. One chapter and the final mission remain after this, and once the credits roll you return to free-roam with everything the 100% checklist needs still within reach.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission — this is the gold story trophy. Save manually before it: after the credits you return to free-roam and the 100% Completion checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) opens, which is where the remaining ~100 hours of the platinum live.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies pop on their own when the mission ends and can never be missed. There is no mission replay, so play each story mission carefully the first time — though no story-mission trophy can ever be locked out.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Mission trophies pop on their own when the mission ends and can never be missed. Heist missions are story beats — just play through and the trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Mission trophies pop on their own when the mission ends and can never be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Mission trophies pop on their own when the mission ends and can never be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Mission trophies pop on their own when the mission ends and can never be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Mission trophies pop on their own when the mission ends and can never be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Hit 100% on the in-game completion checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which opens after the story — but progress counts from the start, so work on it during the story. The requirement is forgiving: closer to 60% true completion. You need 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, and 300 stunts — not everything. This is the hardest trophy and usually the last one before the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps. Any mix counts, and stunts you pull off naturally during the story count too. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: racing, fishing, shooting range, drone races, arcade games, and the rest of the world's pastimes. You only need one attempt at each — no wins required. Sample them as you meet them during the story and mop up the remainder in free-roam.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the shooting ranges across Leonida and gold every challenge — accuracy and speed both matter, so learn each range's layout, then run it clean. Ranges stay open after the story, so there is no rush.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location hosts its own race — win one at every spot on the map. Learn the racing line at each location; the races stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so you need 20 distinct events, not 20 wins of the same one. Work through the race types across Leonida (street, off-road, boat and air where offered) and tick them off as you go.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Out-fish Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at the fishing spots, match his catch, then beat it. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so this also feeds Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play one arcade game through to its end — any arcade cabinet will do. Arcades are scattered across Leonida's towns and Vice City itself; one finished game is all it takes.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's mission strand through to his final mission. Side-character strands unlock as you meet the characters in the world — take their missions whenever they appear, and the strand ends with a final mission that pops this trophy. Strands can be finished after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission. Take his missions whenever they appear in the world; the strand ends with a final mission that pops this trophy. Strands can be finished after the story.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's mission strand through to his final mission. Take his missions whenever they appear in the world; the strand ends with a final mission that pops this trophy. Strands can be finished after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some side questlines count toward the 8, and guide writers are still confirming exactly which — finish the stranger strands you find (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and the rest) and this pops with the eighth. All strands stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's mission strand through to his final mission. Take his missions whenever they appear in the world; the strand ends with a final mission that pops this trophy. Strands can be finished after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. Take his missions whenever they appear in the world; the strand ends with a final mission that pops this trophy. Strands can be finished after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations in Leonida, with Jason and Lucia. THIS IS THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter — meditate there before Chapter 1 ends. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter. The remaining spots stay available after the story.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand asks you to track down a specific rare animal — follow his missions, find the animal's territory, and take the shot. Studying animals with binoculars for the 100% checklist helps you learn the wildlife first.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, houses and hidden spots. Collect every card of a set to complete it; three completed sets pop the trophy. Cards stay collectible after the story, so sweep them in free-roam with a checklist.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK It is the in-world photo/tagging activity — use it at landmarks, viewpoints and points of interest until you hit 100 distinct spots. Locations stay available after the story.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and more — pick the easiest 50. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so the hardest ones can be skipped entirely for the trophy, and you can keep going past 50 for A Long Road.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner (Jason or Lucia) beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Work as a pair: cause heat together, then break line of sight, swap cars, and hide until the wanted level clears. Open country with plentiful escape routes makes it easier.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without ever losing your wanted level — the streak only counts if the heat stays on the whole time. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast one after another, and keep moving: the wanted level must stay active from the first robbery to the third.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get in, or scan, 100 different vehicle models across Leonida. Scan vehicles with the in-game scanner as you meet them (200 of 277 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes naturally on the way). Variety beats repetition: new models count, repeats do not.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus (the slow-motion aiming mode). Set it up where enemies cluster — a gang hideout or a shootout with plenty of targets — trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends. Ammo and cover matter more than speed here.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — leave VCIA by air in an aircraft of your own, not through the terminal. Get onto the airfield, take a plane, and clear the airport's airspace.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get behind the controls of a Rhino tank — the description's 'Rhinos' is the tank's name. Find one at a military site or during a high-heat encounter, climb in, and put it to use.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm. Go in quiet: case the store first, move when the staff's backs are turned, take the goods and leave before anyone notices. A stealthy approach beats a loud one here.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Plan each hit: get in, crack the vault, grab the cash, and break away clean before the response closes in. Five successful vault jobs — escapes count, so a getaway plan matters as much as the robbery itself.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush one on the road — stop it, crack it open, take the cash, and lose the heat. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida, so pick a quiet stretch of road for the hit.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — visit every region of the map, from Vice City and Vice Beach to the swamps, the Keys and the northern counties. The game tracks which areas you have been to; a full sweep of the map pops the trophy. Use the in-game map to spot the corners you have not visited yet.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Every gang runs its own rackets — find each gang's operation, hit it, and get out. You need one per gang, so learn which crews control which corners of the map.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — find a bar on the Ocean Beach strip, order a cocktail, and take it in with the ocean in front of you. A quiet moment, not a mission.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — steal a car from a showroom by driving it straight through the glass front and out onto the street. Pick a showroom with a big front window and floor it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play through a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — follow through to the end of the game. Find the alley, rent a lane, and finish what you started.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership activity that draws a crowd — the exact trigger is still being pinned down by guide writers, so this entry marks it unconfirmed rather than guessing. Check the cited guide for the confirmed method once it lands.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Your choices across the game shape the profile — but be careful: do not push toward the Irredeemable profile, which is permanent. Play naturally and let the count build; the profile shifts with what you do.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Something you land on the second try — the exact trigger is still being pinned down by guide writers, so this entry marks it unconfirmed rather than guessing. Check the cited guide for the confirmed method once it lands.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A strange encounter somewhere in Leonida — the exact trigger is still being pinned down by guide writers, so this entry marks it unconfirmed rather than guessing. Check the cited guide for the confirmed method once it lands.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl your targets over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle using a melee weapon, not a gun. Line up a group, drive past swinging, and knock them down.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the cleaned total counts toward the $250,000. Robberies feed this directly, so it grows as you work the other robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, car mods, anything with a price tag. Spending counts across every shop type, so buy what you need as you play and the total climbs on its own. Big-ticket items (cars, weapons) get you there fastest.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property in Leonida. Garages are bought through the in-game property listings — save up, buy each one, and the trophy pops with the last. Garages also store the vehicles you register for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, bring them to a registration point, and log them in the app — ten registered vehicles pops the trophy. Rare and common vehicles count the same.
